contradictions.contradiction: Explosive AI demand coexists with rising concern about third-party model data governance.
Rapid AI-driven adoption and sovereign-control positioning coexist with dependence on external model providers whose retention policies may conflict with sensitive-data requirements.
contradictions.disposition: real but bounded; architecture/provider diversification can mitigate it, and current evidence does not show material demand impairment

contradictions.statement: Large remaining deal value supports demand visibility, but contractual termination/options mean it cannot be treated as committed revenue.

Large RDV supports demand visibility while contractual termination/options reduce certainty of realization; both can be true simultaneously, so this is a calibration tension rather than evidence that demand is impaired.
